Coordinator The Research and Development Cell fosters a culture of innovation and research among students. It provides resources, mentorship and opportunities for hands-on projects, encouraging members to explore new technologies and solutions. Through workshops, seminars and collaborations, the cell helps students develop critical research skills for academic and professional growth. Events Reports Waste Management Workshop Report To educate students on the importance of waste segregation and recycling things in the society Three-Day Faculty Workshop on Survey Project The Department of Commerce, in association with the Research Club, organised a three-day faculty workshop on “Survey Project – 5th Semester B.Com”. The workshop focused on strengthening faculty understanding of research fundamentals, research design, sampling, and data analysis. The sessions provided practical guidance to faculty members to effectively mentor students in their survey projects. Five-Day Students’ Workshop on Survey Project The Department of Commerce, in association with the Research Club, organised a five-day workshop for 5th Semester B.Com students. The sessions guided students through the various stages of a survey project, from developing a research idea and understanding methodology to preparing and presenting a structured research report. The programme aimed to build confidence and practical research skills among students. Three-Day Seminar on “From Research Design to Data Analysis The Research Club organised a three-day seminar on “From Research Design to Data Analysis” for the students of the 5th Semester B.Com. The sessions focused on translating research designs into practical data collection and analysis, enabling students to understand the complete research process. The programme also provided practical exposure to tools and techniques relevant to their ongoing survey projects.
